svg.title: Pull requests by topic, 25 Oct to 14 Nov 2026
svg.desc: Of the 28 pull requests opened from 25 Oct to 14 Nov, 22 merged within days; the 6 still open were all opened on 12 and 13 Nov, among them the decision-model and retry changes.
